Session 2 · Browser Setup

ArcGIS StoryMaps Login

1

Open StoryMaps in the browser

Use the facilitator's browser. StoryMaps is accessed in the browser for this session.

2

Sign in with the issued credentials

Help the facilitator log in and confirm that the account opens successfully.

3

Verify the organisation environment

Do not stop at the public ArcGIS StoryMaps page. The facilitator must reach the organisation's StoryMaps content area.

Starting pointThis is the public StoryMaps page. The facilitator still needs to sign in.
Correct destinationThe facilitator is inside the organisation StoryMaps content area and can see authorised programme content.
